data.gender_notes: Jireh is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jireh is recorded in name-lists as “God will provide”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jireh expresses “God will provide”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jireh total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_latin.name: Ireh
in_latin.meaning: nomen Dei, aperitivum a nomine Hebraico
in_latin.long_meaning: Iure divino dictum a Deo, qui est aperitivus a nomine Hebraico, significans Dominus Providentia, in scriptis Veteris Testamenti, in Novo Testamentum, in Ecclesia Primitiva, in traditione Christiana.
